blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Continual learners that keep a task-specific adapter in every block of a pre-trained vision transformer accumulate storage linearly with the number of tasks; keeping task-specific adapters in only a few blocks curbs this growth but raises the question of where to place them. We investigate this question from two perspectives. Algorithmically, training all contiguous four-block placements yields an inverted U: final accuracy peaks at intermediate depth and varies by up to 3.5 percentage points (pp), while inexpensive criteria based on weight spectra or activation statistics favor the deepest blocks. From neuroscience, the hierarchical organization and intermediate-stage plasticity of the visual cortex motivate us to ask whether a measurement taken outside the learner can guide layer specialization without placement search. LS-B observes the first tasks through a frozen fMRI encoding model of twelve human visual areas and commits task-specific capacity once to the blocks whose readouts vary most across tasks relative to their stable structure. Across three ViT-B/16 backbones, LS-B yields stable, backbone-specific allocations. On the two backbones with placement search, AugReg and iBOT, the selected blocks overlap the intermediate-depth region identified by search. Under matched storage and observation budgets, the selected blocks outperform the shallowest and deepest four-block configurations. On Split ImageNet-R, LS-B uses 60% of full-BiLoRA adapter storage while remaining within 1.5 pp of its final accuracy. The allocation requires no labels or backpropagation, adds under 0.6% runtime, and exhibits backbone-specific cortical signatures.
blocks.zh: 连续学习者在预先训练的视觉变压器的每块中保留一个任务特定的适配器,随任务数量线性地积累;只将任务特定的适配器保留在几个街区内,抑制了这种增长,但提出了放置位置的问题. 我们从两个角度来调查这个问题。 从理论上讲,所有毗连的四块布置的训练都会产生一个倒转的U:最后精度峰值位于中间深度,最高可达3.5个百分点(pp),而基于重量光谱或激活统计的廉价标准则有利于最深的块. 从神经科学来看,视觉皮层的层次组织和中间阶段的可塑性激励着我们询问,在学习者之外进行的测量是否能够指导层层的专业化,而不进行放置搜索. LS-B通过12个人类视觉区域的冷冻fMRI编码模型观察最初的任务,并将任务特定能力一次承诺给任务阅读量与其稳定结构相比差异最大的区块. 跨越三个Vit-B/16主干线,LS-B产生稳定的、针对主干线的分配。 在安装搜索的两个主干上,AugReg和iBOT,选定的块与搜索确定的中间深度区域重叠。 在相应的储存和观察预算下,选定的区块比最浅和最深的四区块配置要好。 在Split ImageNet-R上,LS-B使用60%的全BiLORA适配器存储,同时保持在其最终准确度的1.5pp以内. 分配不需要标签或反向传播,在0.6%的运行时间内增加,并显示骨干特有的皮层签名。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Pre-trained vision transformers with parameter-efficient modules are a strong basis for rehearsal-free class-incremental learning ( Wang et al., 2022b ; Wang et al., 2022a ; Liang and Li, 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) . If the learner keeps a task-specific module in every block, as BiLoRA does ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) , the parameters it retains grow linearly with the task sequence. Keeping task-specific capacity in only k k of the L L blocks and sharing one parameter-efficient adaptation module elsewhere (hereafter, adapter ) curbs this growth ( He et al., 2025 ) , but raises a structural question: which blocks should keep task-specific capacity? On 10-task Split ImageNet-R, moving a four-block task-specific window along a ViT-B/16 changes final accuracy by up to 2.8 and 3.5 pp on two backbones at identical storage (Figure 1 a).
blocks.zh: 具有参数效率模块的预训视觉变压器是排练无课增量学习的有力基础(王等人,2022b;王等人,2022a;梁和李,). 2024; 朱等, 2025). 如果学习者在每个块中保留一个任务特定模块,如BiLORA所做的(Zhu等人,2025年),它保留的参数随着任务序列的线性增长. 在LL区块中仅保留kk的任务特定能力,在其他地方共享一个参数高效的适应模块(以下简称适配器)会抑制这种增长(He等人,2025年),但提出了结构性问题:哪些区块应该保持任务特定能力? 在10 task Split ImageNet-R上,沿着一个Vit-B/16移动一个四块任务特定窗口,在相同的存储器(图1a)的两个骨干上修改最终精度可达2.8和3.5pp.

blocks.en: The algorithmic route to an answer looks inside the learner. Placement can be searched on validation data ( Wang et al., 2022a ; Lee et al., 2023 ) ; CL-LoRA, which fixes the shared/task-specific boundary, notes that “the optimal position could be determined through validation on the first few tasks” ( He et al., 2025 , p. 30540) . On our benchmark, search works, since every contiguous four-block placement trained to completion traces an inverted U with an intermediate optimum, but it costs one full continual-learning run per candidate and seed. Cheaper criteria read a per-layer signal from the learner’s parameters, activations or gradients ( Guo et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Ge et al., 2025 ; Hong et al., 2025 ; Qian et al., 2025 ) ; we find that weight-spectrum and activation criteria favor the deepest blocks and miss the optimum.
blocks.zh: 解答的算法路线看学习者内部. 可在验证数据上查找位置(Wang等人,2022a); Lee et al., 2023);CL-LORA,它确定了共享/任务特定边界,它指出,“最佳位置可以通过对第一批几项任务的验证来确定”(He et al., 2025, p. 30540). 根据我们的基准,搜索工作,因为每个连续四个街区的安置 训练完成 都跟一个倒转的U 和中间最佳,但它花费一个完整的持续学习 运行每个候选人和种子。 廉价标准读取了学习者参数、激活或梯度的每层信号(Guo等人,2025年;Li等人,2025年;Ge等人,2025年;Hong等人,2025年;Qian等人,2025年);我们发现,重量谱和激活标准有利于最深的区块,没有达到最佳标准。

blocks.en: The neuroscience route looks outside the learner. Deep vision networks parallel the ventral stream, with early layers predicting early visual cortex and later layers higher areas ( Yamins et al., 2014 ; Güçlü and van Gerven, 2015 ) , and layer-resolved encoding models assign each cortical location to the network depth that predicts it best ( Yang et al., 2024 ) . In adult visual cortex, perceptual learning modifies responses in the intermediate area V4 ( Yang and Maunsell, 2004 ; Raiguel et al., 2006 ) , while plasticity of early visual cortex is constrained by critical periods ( Hensch, 2005 ) , which have an analogue in deep networks ( Achille et al., 2019 ) . These findings leave open where task-specific capacity belongs and motivate a question: can an independently fitted neural measurement of how each block maps onto visual cortex locate the blocks that need task-specific capacity without labels or placement search?
blocks.zh: 神经科学路线看在学习者之外. 深视网平行于通风溪流,早期地层预测早期视觉皮层,后期地层较高区域(Yamins等人,2014年;Güçlü和van Gerven,2015年),层解编码模型将每个皮层位置指定给网络深度,预言其最佳(Yang等人,2024年). 在成人视觉皮质中,知觉学习会改变中间区域V4(Yang and Maunsell,2004年;Raiguel等人,2006年)的响应,而早期视觉皮质的可塑性则受到临界期(Hensch,2005年)的制约,在深层网络中具有类似物(Achille等人,2019年). 这些发现在任务特定能力属于哪个领域留下了空白,并激发了一个问题:能否独立地对每个块图在视觉皮层上如何定位需要任务特定能力的块进行神经测量,而不进行标签或放置搜索?

blocks.en: We answer with LS-B (Layer Specialization from external Brain readouts), an observe-then-commit rule (Figure 2 ). During the first K K tasks every block is task-specific, while a frozen fMRI encoding model of twelve human visual areas reads an adapter-free copy of the backbone on each task’s unlabeled images. LS-B then scores each block by how much its readout varies across tasks relative to its stable part, commits task-specific capacity once to the k k highest-scoring blocks, and lets the other blocks share one continually updated adapter.
blocks.zh: 我们用LS-B(Layer专业从外部大脑读取)来回答,这是观察时承诺的规则(图2 ). 在最初的K K任务期间,每个块都是任务特异性的,而12个人类视觉区域的冻结的fMRI编码模型读取每个任务无标签图像上的无适配器主干件. LS-B然后根据每个块相对于其稳定部位的不同任务读出量进行分数,将任务特定容量承诺一次给 k 最高积分块,让其他块共享一个不断更新的适配器.

blocks.en: The two routes meet (Figure 1 ): the readout is not concentrated in the deepest blocks and commits blocks in the intermediate band found by placement search. The readout recovers the intermediate-region preference without recovering the search optimum: the selected sets overlap with the best-performing window by one to three blocks out of four, and its ranking of candidate placements shows no detectable correlation with their accuracy. Our contributions are (i) a measurement of the algorithmic route: placement follows an inverted U with an intermediate optimum that spectral and activation criteria miss (§ 5.1 ); (ii) a method from the neuroscience route: a frozen, layer-resolved fMRI readout turned into a one-time shared/task-specific partition without labels, backpropagation or search (§ 3 ); and (iii) evidence of convergence and of its price: gains over both extremes at matched storage and observation, 60% of full-adapter storage within 1.5 pp of its accuracy, and backbone-specific cortical signatures (§ 5.2 –§ 5.5 ).
blocks.zh: 两条路线相遇(图1):读取不集中在最深处的区块上,并承担通过放置搜索发现的中间带的区块. 读出后恢复了中间区域的偏好,但没有恢复最佳的搜索:所选的套件与表现最好的窗口重叠了4个街区中的1到3个街区,其候选人职位的排列显示与其准确性没有可察觉的关联性. 我们的贡献是:(一) 算法路线的衡量:放置在逆变的U之后,中间优化的光谱和激活标准缺失(第5.1节);(二) 神经科学路线的一种方法:冷冻的、分层解的fMRI读出器变为一次性共享/特定任务分区,没有标签、反放大或搜索(第3节);(三) 趋同及其价格的证据:在匹配的存储和观察中,在准确度1.5pp范围内,在完全适应器存储器的60%,以及骨干特有的皮质特征(第5.2 –§ 5.5节)。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: With pre-trained backbones, continual learners ( Wang et al., 2024 ) adapt per task through adapters ( Houlsby et al., 2019 ) , prompts ( Wang et al., 2022b ; Wang et al., 2022a ) or low-rank updates ( Hu et al., 2022 ; Liang and Li, 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) , often separating shared from task-specific knowledge ( Wang et al., 2022a ; He et al., 2025 ) . Adapting only the first session can already provide a strong continual-learning baseline ( Panos et al., 2023 ; Zhou et al., 2025a ) ; RanPAC likewise adopts this strategy as its first phase ( McDonnell et al., 2023 ) . The observation stage of LS-B is related to this form of early adaptation; after observation, LS-B also fixes the layer-wise capacity allocation. A similar observe-then-commit idea appears in adaptive-rank fine-tuning ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) . LoRA-drop keeps LoRA in the layers with the most important LoRA outputs and shares one LoRA across the remaining layers ( Zhou et al., 2025b ) . Automatic per-layer capacity allocation is also a central objective of D-MoLE ( Ge et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 有了经过预训的骨干,继续学习者(Wang等人,2024年)通过适配器适应每个任务 (Houlsby等人, 2019), points. (Wang等人,2022b;Wang等人,2022a)或低级更新. (Hu等人,2022年;Liang and Li,2024年;Zhu等人,2025年),常与特定任务知识分离(Wang等人,2022a; He等人,2025年). 调整后,只有第一阶段才能提供强有力的持续学习基线(Panos等人,2023年;Zhou等人,2025年a年);RanPAC同样将该战略作为第一阶段(McDonnell等人,2023年)。 LS-B的观测阶段与这种早期适应形式有关;在观测后,LS-B还修正了层位能力分配. 类似的观察-当时的承诺思想出现在适应-排名微调中(张等人,2023年). LoRA-drop将LORA保留在层中,拥有最重要的LORA产出,并共享一个LORA横跨其余层(周等人,2025年b). 每层能力自动分配也是D-MOLE(Ge等人,2025年)的中心目标.

blocks.en: Layer-wise allocation is decided by fixed rules ( He et al., 2025 ) , by search or validation ( Wang et al., 2022a ; Lee et al., 2023 ) , by empirical comparison of placements ( Yin et al., 2024 ) , or by learner-derived signals: representational similarity ( Guo et al., 2025 ) , sensitivity statistics ( Li et al., 2025 ) , gradient magnitudes ( Ge et al., 2025 ) , learned gates ( Hong et al., 2025 ) or gradient similarity ( Qian et al., 2025 ) , in networks whose features become more task-specific with depth ( Yosinski et al., 2014 ) . All of these read their evidence from the learning system; LS-B obtains its allocation signal through a frozen neural encoding model fitted independently of the continual-learning process.
blocks.zh: 分层分配由固定规则决定(He等人,2025年),通过搜索或验证决定(Wang等人,2022a; Lee et al., 2023),通过对安置(Yin et al., 2024)的实证比较,或通过学习者得出的信号: 代表性相似性(Guo et al., 2025),灵敏度统计(Li et al., 2025),梯度级(Ge et al., 2025),学习门(Hong et al., 2025)或梯度相似性(Qian et al., 2025),其特征随着深度而更加具体的任务(Yosinski et al., 2014). 所有这些人都从学习系统中读取证据;LS-B通过一个与持续学习过程无关的冷冻神经编码模型获得分配信号。

blocks.en: Networks are compared with neural data along the ventral stream ( Yamins et al., 2014 ; Güçlü and van Gerven, 2015 ; Schrimpf et al., 2020 ) , and layer-resolved encoding models map voxels onto layers ( Yang et al., 2024 ) ; LS-B uses such a model as a frozen instrument. Neural data have regularized models ( Li et al., 2019 ; Federer et al., 2020 ) , with part of the benefit matched by non-neural data of similar statistics ( Federer et al., 2020 ) , fine-tuned language and speech models ( Schwartz et al., 2019 ; Moussa et al., 2025 ; Vattikonda et al., 2025 ; Moussa and Toneva, 2025 ) , and informed the choice of intervention layers ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) . Brain-inspired continual learners import complementary memories ( Kemker and Kanan, 2018 ) , expert gating ( Aljundi et al., 2017 ) , internal replay ( van de Ven et al., 2020 ) or random-expanded routing ( Yan et al., 2026 ) ; LS-B uses a layer-resolved neural measurement directly in the layer-allocation rule.
blocks.zh: 网络与沿排气流的神经数据进行比较(Yamins等人,2014年;Güçlü和van Gerven,2015年;Schrimpf等人,2020年),层解编码模型映射到层上(Yang等人,2024年);LS-B使用这样的模型作为冷冻仪器. 神经学数据已规范化模型(Li等人,2019年;Federer等人,2020年),部分惠益与类似统计数据的非神经学数据相匹配(Federer等人,2020年),微调语言和语音模型(Schwartz等人,2019年;Moussa等人,2025年;Vattikonda等人,2025年;Moussa和Toneva,2025年),并告知了干预层的选择(Xiao等人,2026年)。 脑激发的继续学习者导入互补记忆(Kemker和Kanan,2018年),专家Gating(Aljundi等人,2017年),内部重播(van de Ven等人,2020年)或随机扩展的路由(Yan等人,2026年);LS-B在层分配规则中直接使用层解神经测量.

blocks.zh: 3.1 设置和主机适配器

blocks.en: 3.2 Brain readout
blocks.zh: 3.2 大脑读取

blocks.en:
We fit a FactorTopy encoding model on image–fMRI pairs of subject subj01 of the Natural Scenes Dataset (NSD; Allen et al., 2022 ). It predicts cortical responses from the frozen backbone’s block features through a per-vertex layer-selection weight over the L L blocks, is fitted once per backbone, and is then frozen; no fMRI data are used during continual learning. We read it out in R = 12 R=12 visual regions (V1, V2, V3, V4, EBA, FBA, OFA, FFA, OPA, PPA, OWFA and VWFA), keeping in each region the 500 vertices with the highest validation R 2 R^{2} (details and Figure 8 in Appendix D ).
The regions overlap anatomically: 13.7–14.2% of the retained vertices belong to more than one region, concentrated in a few pairs such as FBA and FFA, whose rows of 𝐃 t \mathbf{D}_{t} below are close to duplicates; we therefore treat the regions as overlapping groups of vertices.

blocks.en: We use Split ImageNet-R ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ; Wang et al., 2022a ) : 200 classes in T = 10 T=10 tasks of 20 disjoint classes under the class-incremental protocol. Our frozen, per-class stratified 80/20 split differs from BiLoRA’s, so absolute accuracies are not comparable with published numbers; the class order is the same in every run. ACC is the final accuracy of a single 200-way classifier on all test images, without task identity, logit masking or exemplars. The ViT-B/16 backbone is initialized from AugReg (supervised, ImageNet-21k; Steiner et al., 2022 ), iBOT ( Zhou et al., 2022 ) or DINO ( Caron et al., 2021 ) (self-supervised, ImageNet-1k). We keep the host adapter’s recipe and hold out no validation data (Appendix B ); defaults are k = 4 k=4 and K = 3 K=3 . All main-text experiments use this benchmark; Appendix F reports registered supplementary runs on Split CIFAR-100, Split CUB-200 and 20-task Split ImageNet-R ( n = 3 n=3 ), with mixed results.

blocks.en: The readout lives in cortical coordinates, so allocations map onto the brain (Figure 7 ). The frozen encoding model orders cortex by depth (a): V1 is best predicted by shallow blocks (modal block 1 or 2), the category-selective areas EBA, FBA, FFA and VWFA by the last block and the scene areas PPA and OPA by blocks 8–9, broadly consistent with the correspondence between depth and the ventral hierarchy ( Yamins et al., 2014 ; Güçlü and van Gerven, 2015 ) ; V2–V4 lie in between, non-monotonically (per-region profiles in Appendix D , Figure 8 ). Weighting the map by how often each block is committed (b) gives LS-B’s cortical footprint: on all three backbones it lies below the uniform 4 / 12 4/12 in V1 and in PPA, OPA and EBA (only marginally for DINO in V1, 0.32, and for AugReg in EBA, 0.33) and peaks in between, at locations that differ between backbones. This is a post-hoc description, partly implied by (a) and the intermediate depth of the committed blocks. The task residual of the top-ranked blocks (c) differs by backbone: V1–V4 carry 31–79% of it, against an equal share of 33%; it concentrates in V4 on iBOT, splits between V2/V4 and FFA/FBA on DINO, and lies mostly in FFA and FBA on AugReg, whose layer selection is diffuse (median per-vertex maximum weight 0.34, lowest of the three). Pre-training thus changes both which blocks are committed and the cortical composition of the signal that commits them (task maps: Figure 10 ). Taken together, this is a coarse correspondence rather than a recovery of the search optimum: the readout identifies the same intermediate band but does not rank candidate placements. We therefore treat it as a structural prior, not a surrogate validation objective. The matched-observation controls further separate this placement effect from the larger gain contributed by the observation stage.
blocks.zh: 读出者生活在皮质坐标,所以分配图在大脑上(图7 ). 冻结的编码模型按深度(a):V1最好通过浅块(模式块1或2)预测,类别选择区EBA,FBA,FFA和VWFA在最后一个区块和场景区PPA和OPA在8-9区块之间大致符合深度与排气层之间的对应(Yamins等人,2014年;Güçlü和van Gerven,2015年);V2–V4位于非杂交区之间(附录D,图8中的每个区域简介)。 按每个区块的频率对地图进行加权(b) 给LS-B的皮层足迹:在所有三个骨干上,它都位于V1和PPA、OPA和EBA的统一4/124/12以下(只有V1、0.32的DINO和EBA的AugReg,0.33),在骨干不同的地点之间和高峰。 这是在浩克之后的描述,部分由(a)和承诺区块的中间深度所暗示。 排名最高的区块的任务剩余量(c)因骨干不同而异:V1–V4承载了其中的31–79%,而所占份额相等于33%;它集中在V4上,在DINO上分为V2/V4和FFA/FBA,在AugReg上则主要位于FFA和FBA中,其层层选择是分散的(中间为垂直最大重量0.34,最低为3个)。 因此,前期训练既改变了所承诺的区块,也改变了所承诺的信号的皮层组成(任务图:图10)。 总而言之,这是粗糙的函证,而不是对最佳搜索的恢复:读出者识别出相同的中间波段,但不给候选人职位排位。 因此,我们把它视为一个结构先验,而不是一个替代鉴定目标。 匹配观测控制进一步将这种放置效应与观测阶段产生的较大收益区分开来.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this study, we introduced LS-B, a method for layer specialization in continual learning based on external brain readouts. Placement search finds an intermediate optimum for task-specific capacity at the price of training every candidate, and cheap internal statistics favor the deepest blocks. A frozen fMRI encoding readout taken during a short observation stage lands in the same intermediate band and, at matched capacity, commits blocks that outperform both extremes; LS-B turns it into a one-time partition that retains 60% of full-adapter storage within 1.5 pp of its accuracy on Split ImageNet-R. Measurements made outside a learner can thus serve as priors for architectural decisions otherwise settled by search or by the learner’s own statistics.
blocks.zh: 在这项研究中,我们引入了LS-B,一种基于外部脑读取的分层专门化持续学习的方法. 职位安排搜索以培训每个候选人为代价,为具体任务的能力找到一个最佳的中间点,廉价的内部统计数据倾向于最深层。 在一个短暂的观测阶段进行fMRI编码读取时,会在同一中间波段进行,并按相应的容量,执行超过两个极端的区块; LS-B将其变成一个一次性分区,在Split ImageNet-R上的精确度的1.5pp范围内保留60%的全适应器存储量。 因此,在学习者之外进行的测量可以作为通过搜索或学习者自己的统计解决的建筑决定的前奏。

The method reduces the storage cost of continual learning; we do not foresee negative societal impacts beyond those of image classification in general.

blocks.en: The readout approaches the search optimum but does not recover the best window or rank placements: we claim that it lands in the right region at the cost of three forward-only readouts, not that it finds the optimum. Most of LS-B’s advantage over same-width static allocations comes from observation, and the placement test rests on three seeds per configuration, with one margin (iBOT against the deepest blocks) depending on the seed reference. All main-text results come from one benchmark and class order, one host adapter, one architecture and one fMRI subject; the neuroscience findings are motivation by analogy; the regions overlap; and at k = 4 k=4 the readout can inject at most log 2 ⁡ ( 12 4 ) ≈ 8.95 \log_{2}\binom{12}{4}\approx 8.95 bits into the allocation.

blocks.en: The train/test partition is stratified per class at 80/20 (24,002/5,998 images, against 24,000/6,000 in BiLoRA’s split), generated once with a fixed seed by a script included in our code. Classes are ordered by the dataset’s index and cut into ten consecutive groups of twenty; the reported variability therefore reflects training noise, not sensitivity to task order. ACC after the last task averages the per-task test accuracies of the single 200-way classifier weighted by the number of test images, which equals pooled accuracy over all 200 classes.

blocks.en: We keep the training configuration released with the host adapter’s code for CIFAR-100 unchanged: Adam with β = ( 0.9 , 0.999 ) \beta=(0.9,0.999) and no weight decay; learning rate 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} for task-specific slots and 0.1 × 0.1\times that rate for shared slots; the host’s cosine schedule; batch size 128; 40 epochs on the first task and 20 on each later task; fp32; random-resized crops to 224 × 224 224\times 224 and horizontal flips for training, resizing to 256 and center cropping for evaluation. No validation split is held out, and no hyper-parameter, epoch budget or checkpoint is selected on the benchmark; the only quantities LS-B estimates from data are the readout statistics, from the unlabeled training images of the observation tasks.

blocks.en: Runs use one NVIDIA RTX 3090 each. A ten-task run of the default LS-B configuration takes on average 2.26, 2.27 and 2.12 h on AugReg, iBOT and DINO, of which selection (three readouts and one ranking) takes about 46, 46 and 40 s. blocks.en: The encoding model is the FactorTopy model of Yang et al. (2024) , fitted separately for each backbone on NSD subject subj01 ( Allen et al., 2022 ) . Because vertices are retained per region and NSD’s region definitions overlap, the 12 × 500 12\times 500 retained positions correspond to 5,246 distinct vertices on AugReg (722, or 13.8%, in at least two regions), 5,214 on iBOT (739, 14.2%) and 5,255 on DINO (719, 13.7%). The overlap is concentrated (FBA ∩ \cap FFA, OFA ∩ \cap OWFA, V4 ∩ \cap OFA), while V1, V2, V3, EBA, OPA and PPA share no retained vertices; the rows of 𝐃 t \mathbf{D}_{t} for FBA and FFA are therefore close to duplicates, and the effective number of independent regions is below twelve. All allocations in this paper were computed with this property; none was recomputed.

blocks.en: Seed-paired differences between LS-B (72 slots) and same-width controls (48 slots): random allocation + 2.32 +2.32 and + 1.83 +1.83 pp on AugReg and iBOT ( n = 16 n=16 ) and + 1.83 +1.83 pp on DINO ( n = 8 n=8 ); gradient norm + 2.00 +2.00 and + 2.29 +2.29 pp, PCA activation + 2.16 +2.16 and + 2.10 +2.10 pp, random-12 activation + 3.26 +3.26 and + 2.05 +2.05 pp (on AugReg identical to the deepest four) and equal partition + 2.15 +2.15 and + 1.60 +1.60 pp ( n = 8 n=8 each).

For a same-width control, let d t d_{t} be the seed-paired difference between LS-B and the control after task t t . We report its value when observation ends (“carry”), its change over the tasks after commitment (“late”) and its final value. Against window 4–7 (seeds 0–2), carry, late and final are 2.15, − 1.13 -1.13 and 1.02 pp on AugReg and 2.30, − 1.02 -1.02 and 1.27 pp on iBOT; against random allocation ( n = 16 n=16 ), 3.66, − 1.34 -1.34 and 2.32 pp and 2.91, − 1.09 -1.09 and 1.83 pp. Under the registered decision rule, a non-positive late change attributes the margin to the observation stage. The two differences are defined on different task sets (three and ten tasks), so the late change is a descriptive attribution, not a variance decomposition. The final margin over random allocation is nevertheless 2.11 and 2.09 times the value that pure dilution of the carry would leave ( 0.3 × 0.3\times carry, since three of ten tasks are observed). On iBOT, two of the three LS-B seeds commit exactly blocks 4–7, so two thirds of the weight of the iBOT comparison with that window comes from pairs that differ only in the observation stage.

blocks.en: After the main experiments we ran a supplement registered before its runs, in four conditions: Split CIFAR-100 ( Krizhevsky, 2009 ) with AugReg (ten tasks of ten classes; the dataset’s 50,000/10,000 split), Split CUB-200 ( Wah et al., 2011 ) with AugReg, iBOT and DINO (ten tasks of twenty classes; the 9,430/2,358 split distributed with the code of Zhou et al., 2025a ), and Split ImageNet-R with T = 20 T=20 tasks of ten classes (AugReg). Classes follow the dataset’s index; the training configuration, the encoding model and the readout are those of the main experiments, and each dataset uses the host’s data pipeline (CIFAR-100 images are upsampled to 224 × 224 224\times 224 ). Each condition trains, with seeds 0–2, all blocks shared, the shallow-first prefixes of 4, 6 and 8 blocks (2, 4 and 6 at T = 20 T=20 ), LS-B with k = 4 k=4 and K = 1 K=1 (which commits blocks 0–3 because ρ ≡ 0 \rho\equiv 0 , and so adds only observation; not run at T = 20 T=20 ), LS-B with k = 2 k=2 and k = 4 k=4 at K = 3 K=3 , and full BiLoRA. The operating points were fixed on ImageNet-R before these runs and were not re-selected, and the registered iBOT × \times CIFAR-100 condition was not run (Appendix G ). With three seeds per configuration we report seed ranges and make no significance claims; the 0.42 pp yardstick was measured on ImageNet-R and is not applied here. Tables 3 – 5 and Figure 12 report every configuration of every condition.

blocks.en: Hypotheses, thresholds and decision rules for the confirmatory comparisons were written down and time-stamped before the corresponding runs were launched; the matched-observation readouts were registered before those runs were launched; the k k and K K sweeps were added after the confirmatory runs had been judged and are exploratory. The confirmatory family had four criteria per backbone (AugReg, iBOT): a gain of at least 1 pp over random allocation (held); a gain over the same-width controls (held against both activation criteria; the equal-partition control was excluded as a ceiling arm, and a registered response-shuffled control was not run because an offline check found it numerically degenerate); accuracy within 0.42 pp of the best static shallow-first allocation; and backbone-specific placement (both failed: the best static allocation is full BiLoRA on both backbones, 1.46 and 0.47 pp above LS-B). The supplementary conditions (Appendix F ) were registered before their runs as exploratory analyses with two directional predictions. Decision rules that require the point estimate to cross a threshold have at most 50% power when the true effect equals the threshold. With n n paired differences, the smallest one-sided sign-test p p is 2 − n 2^{-n} (0.125 at n = 3 n=3 , 0.0039 at n = 8 n=8 ), above the corrected level, so non-parametric tests serve only as robustness checks. For the rank analyses of § 5.2 , α = .0125 \alpha=.0125 is a per-backbone level; over two backbones the family-wise error rate is about .0248. The 0.42 pp yardstick is one pair of AugReg runs with k = 6 k=6 , measured before a fix to the random-number handling of an earlier selector.
